name: Water Connection for ₹100 to BPL/Poor Families Residing in Urban Areas of Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this scheme, a water connection is provided for a nominal fee of ₹100/- to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of an urban area in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant’s family must belong to a BPL (Below Poverty Line) or economically weaker category. 1. The applicant must own a plot of land measuring up to 100 square meters and have constructed, be constructing, or plan to construct a building on the same plot; such applicants will be eligible for a water connection at ₹100/-.
